fixtureProfile.purpose: availability decision with complete RailDefinition authentication
fixtureProfile.signedScope: complete RailDefinition with only signature omitted; unknown members preserved
fixtureProfile.signature: RailSignature.algorithm=ed25519; value is unpadded Base64URL Ed25519(dacs-rail:v1: || lowercase-hex digest)
fixtureProfile.productionContext: trusted local-operator-policy input; counterparty and discovery hints are non-authoritative
fixtureProfile.nodeCompletedHandlers: trusted local-operator-policy list of handlers the pinned node completes; required before any operational pay-cross-chain-liquidity-tank availability is selectable (DEMOS-MAPPING A.5)
